verdict.rationale: Smooth documents structured outputs, activated by setting a `response_model` field, so developers can write deterministic code on the agent's output. It also offers a session `extract` method that pulls structured data from the current page against a provided schema, plus structured data extraction in the CLI. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of Pydantic/Zod model support and of schema validation behavior (e.g., errors on mismatch), and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction reliability.
